description: Terrain tile materials + textures: repalette all tile materials to the limited premium felt palette, make them matte (no glossy spec, no emissive turf), and add CHEAP PROCEDURAL texture so tiles are NOT flat albedo fields - felt grain + mowing stripes on fairway/green (aligned to the hole's tee->flag play direction), fine ripple on sand, grass-tuft break-up on rough/deep-rough, and a physical/beveled light-catch read. All tile edits target the scenes/tiles/*-mesh.tres files (the authoritative in-game materials via mesh_map); unit_hex_*.tscn are unused and must NOT be edited. Depends on FEAT-001 (materials are tuned against the new neutral ambient).
steps: Fix green: in scenes/tiles/green-mesh.tres first sub_resource (StandardMaterial3D_td1sn) set albedo_color=Color(0.341,0.580,0.282,1) (#579448), REMOVE emission_enabled=true and rim_enabled=true, set roughness=1.0 metallic=0.0 specular~0.1. Do NOT touch the ArrayMesh data. This also fixes FLAG tiles (reuse green-mesh).

Repalette + matte the rest (first sub_resource of each file): fairway-mesh.tres #3c7140; rough-mesh.tres #2f5030; deeprough-mesh.tres ~#1f3a22 (darker same family); sand-mesh.tres #d2bd84; teebox-mesh.tres #c7b48a (fixes the pure-black tee, Color(0,0,0,1)); water-mesh.tres base #4b7892 with metallic~0.1 roughness~0.35 (muted slate, keep its triplanar JPG for now); ground-mesh.tres hex base ~#4a3a24. All matte (roughness 1.0 / low metallic, specular~0.1) except water.

Author scripts/turf.gdshader (shader_type spatial): flat/soft-cel diffuse over a base_color uniform; procedural felt grain = fine value-noise modulating albedo +-3-5% and a little roughness; mowing stripes = sin(dot(world_xz, stripe_dir)*stripe_freq) softened into alternating +-4-6% lightness bands. Derive world_xz from (MODEL_MATRIX*vec4(VERTEX,1.0)).xz so bands are continuous across all MultiMesh instances. Uniforms: base_color, stripe_dir(vec2), stripe_freq, stripe_strength, grain_strength, roughness. No texture fetch (cheap).

Assign turf.gdshader as the first-sub_resource material of fairway-mesh.tres and green-mesh.tres (green: tighter stripe_freq, gentler stripe_strength). Keep the fairway/green ArrayMesh geometry intact.

Align stripes to play direction from script: add _apply_mowing_direction() in hex_grid.gd, called at the END of _generate_grid(), computing dir = normalize(world(flag_position) - world(tee_position)).xz (both known to hex_grid) and calling set_shader_parameter('stripe_dir', dir) on the fairway and green MultiMesh materials (reach them via the multimesh_nodes map / mesh_map materials; store refs during _generate_grid if needed). Default stripe_dir to Vector2(0,1) if tee/flag undefined. Do NOT change any generation/layout/positions.

Author ripple + tuft: either add uniform/flag variants to turf.gdshader or sibling shaders scripts/sand.gdshader (fine sin-based ripple from world_xz, low amplitude, modulating albedo+roughness) and scripts/rough_turf.gdshader (higher-frequency mottled grass-tuft noise, NO stripes). Assign to sand-mesh.tres, rough-mesh.tres, deeprough-mesh.tres first-sub_resource materials.

Physical/beveled read: rely on FEAT-001's key light + SSAO, plus a shader rim-darken in turf.gdshader (darken fragments where world-space height/normal is steep) and a slightly darker AO-ish ground-mesh base so bevels read as crafted pieces. Do NOT regenerate/edit tile ArrayMesh geometry.

Keep all turf/sand/rough texture procedural. Only if procedural grain reads flat in review shots, author ONE small <=256x256 PNG textures/felt_grain.png (import with repeat) and sample it in turf.gdshader; keep it the sole baked texture.
acceptance_criteria: No tile material renders as a flat single-albedo field: fairway and green show mowing stripes aligned to the hole direction, sand shows ripple, rough/deep-rough show tuft break-up (observable in the AFTER screenshots captured in the convergence step).
green-mesh.tres has no emission_enabled/rim_enabled; teebox is no longer pure black; all turf is matte (no glossy specular, no emissive turf).
Every *-mesh.tres albedo matches the target palette (fairway #3c7140, green #579448, rough #2f5030, sand #d2bd84, water #4b7892, tee #c7b48a).
stripe_dir is set from tee->flag at generation time via _apply_mowing_direction() without altering tile positions/generation.
V1 no output; V2 no SCRIPT ERROR/parse error; V3 test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0; V4 test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0 (the hex_grid helper must not break generation or the turn loop).
verification: /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/artpass --quit-after 400 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|not found|null|invalid|nonexistent" | grep -viE "shader|vulkan|rendering device|headless"  (expect no output)
findings: Authored three procedural spatial shaders (no texture fetch; NO baked felt_grain.png was needed - procedural grain compiled and all gates passed). scripts/turf.gdshader (fairway+green): uniforms base_color(vec4 source_color), stripe_dir(vec2), stripe_freq(float), stripe_strength(float), grain_strength(float), roughness(float); world-space XZ derived from MODEL_MATRIX*VERTEX in a varying so felt grain + mowing stripe bands stay continuous across all shared MultiMesh instances; plus a NORMAL.y-based bevel darken (steep hex sides darkened ~22%). scripts/rough_turf.gdshader (rough+deep-rough): uniforms base_color, tuft_scale, tuft_strength, roughness; 2-octave fbm grass-tuft mottling, NO stripes. scripts/sand.gdshader (sand): uniforms base_color, ripple_dir, ripple_freq, ripple_strength, grain_strength, roughness; noise-wobbled sin ripple. Palette applied to first sub_resource of each *-mesh.tres: green #579448 (0.341,0.58,0.282) emission/rim REMOVED, now ShaderMaterial; fairway #3c7140 (0.235,0.443,0.251); rough #2f5030 (0.184,0.314,0.188); deeprough ~#1f3a22 (0.122,0.227,0.133); sand #d2bd84 (0.824,0.741,0.518); teebox was pure black -> #c7b48a (0.78,0.706,0.541) matte StandardMaterial3D; water muted slate #4b7892 (0.294,0.471,0.573) metallic 0.1 roughness 0.35 keeping its triplanar JPG; ground ~#4a3a24 (0.29,0.227,0.141) matte. green reuse covers FLAG tiles; fairway reuse covers TREE tiles. Stripe default = Vector2(0,1) (used when tee/flag undefined). hex_grid.gd: added _apply_mowing_direction() called at END of _generate_grid(); computes dir = normalize(world(flag_position) - tee_position).xz and sets stripe_dir on the fairway+green shader materials via mesh_map[surf].surface_get_material(0) (guarded is ShaderMaterial). green uses tighter stripe_freq=5.0/stripe_strength=0.04, fairway stripe_freq=3.0/stripe_strength=0.05. No generation/layout/position/transform changes. Gates: V1 no output; V2 no SCRIPT ERROR/parse error; V3 test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0; V4 test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0. Shader ext_resources are referenced by path (res://scripts/*.gdshader) and resolve at load; new *.gdshader.uid generated on import.
